sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
As per office report, complainant is served.
Learned counsel for the applicant has relied on the judgment passed by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.8361 of 2020 (Mohd. Zaid vs. State of U.P.), dated 23.05.2023, and submits that anticipatory bail application on behalf of Mohammad Aaman @ Aman vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. sentences.text: juvenile child in conflict with law is maintainable.
Learned A.G.A. has not disputed the aforesaid settled proposition of law.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. apprehending his arrest in Case Crime No.350/2017, under Sections 354(although bail has already been granted vide order dated 5.7.2017 by ACJM, Mohammadi, Kheri), 376, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Mohammadi, District Kheri.
It is alleged in the prosecution case that victim was caught with the applicant in the banana field of Babu Khan and when complainant came on the spot, both ran away from there.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that initially the F.I.R. was lodged under Sections 354,
352 IPC and the applicant has been enlarged on bail in the said offence.
During investigation Section 376 IPC was added therefore, applicant being juvenile/child in conflict with law is seeking this anticipatory bail in added Section 376 IPC.
He submits that statement of the victim under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. are contradictory.
Victim has been examined before the trial court where she has out-rightly denied the prosecution case in the cross-examination.
All the statements of the victim under Sections 161, 164 Cr.P.C. and the statement before the court are contradictory to each other.
Continuous improvement has been made by the victim.
There is no corroborative evidence in support of prosecution case.
Victim was subjected to medical examination and ossification test.
During ossification test she has been found 18-20 years of age.
He submits that applicant has no criminal history.
He submits that applicant has cooperated in the investigation and further undertakes to cooperate in the trial.
Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application, however, could not dispute the facts.

On due consideration to the argument advanced by parties' counsel and perusal of the record, I find that it would be appropriate to direct the applicant to appear/surrender before the Juvenile Justice Board by moving appropriate application for bail within 15 days from today and in case such an application is filed by the applicant, the same shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously by the Board, strictly in accordance with law after giving opportunity to the parties.
Ordered accordingly.
The application is disposed of, in terms of above.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
